# A07 independent review — 2026-09-15

Reviewer: `review_a06_a07`. Scope: backend closeout, Void, persisted history integration and
pinned-source fidelity. Browser/visual acceptance is coordinator-owned and is not claimed here.

## Source research before repair

The owning [formal closeout contract](../../table-spec.md#formal-encounter-closeout) confirms
common temporary Stamina clearing, source exceptions manually adjudicated, and preservation of
ordinary Stamina and condition toggles. The pinned
[Temporary Stamina](../../../vendor/steel-compendium/en/unified/md/rule/health/temporary-stamina.md)
rule applies to a creature, not only a hero: “Unless otherwise indicated, temporary Stamina
disappears at the end of an encounter.” Therefore a surviving foe retained in the campaign roster
must also lose temporary Stamina during normal Finish cleanup. The A07 checklist's hero examples
do not override that source or owning contract. Void must continue to skip this cleanup.

Finding: the initial A07 backend clears heroes only. Repair authorized by coordinator: clear each
surviving foe's temporary Stamina with a cause-linked before/after journal event. Preserve normal
Stamina and conditions, protect the temporary pool from non-Director reads, and do not repeat on
retry. This repair needs another reviewer's inspection because this reviewer implements it.

## Review outcome

**Pass for backend/code and source fidelity.** The original A07 implementation was independently
reviewed here. Coordinator `/root` independently reviewed the retained-foe repair above against
the same source, its journal and privacy projection, and reran the affected persisted tests.

- Verified pinned [Surges](../../../vendor/steel-compendium/en/unified/md/rule/resource/surge.md),
  [Victories](../../../vendor/steel-compendium/en/unified/md/rule/resource/victories.md),
  [Malice](../../../vendor/steel-compendium/en/unified/md/rule/monster/malice.md), and
  [Combat](../../../vendor/steel-compendium/en/unified/md/chapter/combat.md). Normal cleanup clears
  the named pools and common Malice; ordinary Stamina and manual condition toggles survive.
  Victory amount and recipients are explicitly confirmed, including zero, with once-only cause-linked
  grants. The UI asks the Director to choose source-earned recipients; foe elimination does not award.
- End closes structure and unused optional cards/opportunities without dispatching an ordinary
  turn/group/round boundary. Current v0.01 unresolved source clauses remain explicit optional manual
  continuations. No unsupported required engine resolution is claimed.
- Finish requires confirmed awards, closes unused choices, removes defeated foes, releases combat
  locks and establishes the archive floor. Stale controls, attacks and turns during closeout are
  refused. Current manual dispositions remain available; archived dispositions/corrections do not.
- Void keep retains current live values without rewards/cleanup; reset restores the recorded hero,
  foe-roster and Malice snapshot, removes later additions and aliases recreated foe IDs. It does not
  recreate removed accounts/access or claim deferred loot/squad persistence. Paused Void preserves
  the pause and roster lock. Session close requires an explicit keep/reset choice during combat.
- The new retained-foe regression first failed with temporary Stamina 37 surviving cleanup, then
  passed with a single cause-linked `live.temporaryStamina` journal change, unchanged ordinary
  Stamina, idempotent retry and a public event omitting the private pool. Root independently checked
  this repair and its audience projection.
